title: Understanding Fixed Deposits (FD)
content: A Fixed Deposit (FD) is a financial instrument provided by banks and NBFCs which provides investors a higher rate of interest than a regular savings account until the given maturity date. A lump sum amount is locked in for a fixed tenure (ranging from 7 days to 10 years) at a guaranteed interest rate. FDs offer capital protection and predictable returns, making them suitable for conservative investors or short-term goal preservation.
